issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the new models, factories, migrations and policies despite conventions requiring every feature to ship with tests including authorization and failure paths.

conventions.evidence: Migrations use generator-style anonymous classes with reversible down() dropIfExists, $fillable deliberate (Entity.php:36, EntityMembership.php:21), authorization via app/Policies, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md updated; deviation: zero test files violates TDD 'No production code without a test'.

readability.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:38 getRouteKeyName, :46 memberships, :55 users, :66 owner; app/Models/EntityMembership.php scopes owner/admin/employee plus entity/user relations; typed HasMany/BelongsToMany/HasOne/BelongsTo with PHPDoc; no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:38 return slug, :36 fillable name/slug, :46 memberships, :55 users withPivot role, :66 owner HasOne where Owner; EntityMembership casts role=>UserRole plus scopes owner/admin/employee and entity/user; UserRole Owner/Admin/Employee + manageable [Admin,Employee]; User memberships/entities/membershipFor; migrations: entities slug unique entities_slug_unique + softDeletes, memberships FK cascade + role default employee + owner_seq storedAs case when role='owner' + uniques entity_memberships_entity_user_unique/one_owner; EntityPolicy create/view/update/delete/manageSettings and EntityMembershipPolicy view/assignRole/delete match task; factories and docs/database-schema.md replacing owner_membership_id.

scope.evidence: Diff only adds Entity/EntityMembership/UserRole, User relations, two factories, two migrations, two policies plus required docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md updates; no routes, pages, session, locale, invitations, queues/tickets or billing.

security.evidence: app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php: create true, view member-only, update/delete Owner/Admin-only, manageSettings Owner-only; app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php: view member-only, assignRole Owner/Admin-only, delete blocks Owner role plus self-or-Owner/Admin; $fillable deliberate, no secrets or unsafe output; checked — no issues found.

simplicity.evidence: Lean models/enum/policies/migrations reusing HasFactory, SoftDeletes, belongsToMany, casts, storedAs; no service layers or speculative abstractions; minimum code covering persistence plus policies.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ paths or Pest/PHPUnit files; no coverage for entities, memberships, single-owner invariant, factories, or policy allow/deny paths.

review.summary: Adds entities/entity_memberships persistence with the portable single-owner invariant, models, UserRole enum, factories and Entity/EntityMembership policies plus schema docs and changelog. Functionally complete and secure, but it ships with zero tests in violation of TDD, so it needs substantial rework before merging.
